# Pull request

## Purpose and behavior

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Use synthetic examples only.

## Verification

- [ ] Rust formatting, Clippy, tests, and build pass with the lockfile.
- [ ] Architecture guard and receiver tests pass.
- [ ] Changed UI interactions were checked in a browser, if applicable.
- [ ] Security/trust-boundary changes and remaining limits are documented.

Include commands/results and any unverified behavior. Do not include real secrets,
keys, full sharing URLs, or clipboard contents.
